title: Evaluation of a valid source at layout zero
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $n$ be a natural number, and let $s$ be a bit source valid for input width $n$, block width equal to the number of possible snapshots of $M$ plus $5$, and layout index $0$. For any list $x$ of input bits and any list $bs$ of blocks of bits, evaluating $s$ on $x$ and $bs$ gives the same Boolean value as evaluating $s$ on $x$ and an empty list of blocks.
